name: Bruno Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Bruno was baptized on 23 March 1751, son of Gaetano Ferlaino and Candida Colosimo (S1). He married Francesca Moraca on 3 November 1777 (S2). Their sons Nicola Maria (1778) and Vincenzo (1781) both head lines that lead to John.
